document: ПИЛВ 0102-004, part 1, version 2 (0102v2) — BOS control commands over CAN 2.0B
tables: 4.10 (commands to the BOS), 4.11 (commands sent by the BOS); data fields: tables 4.12-4.46

format.data: commands with data always carry 8 bytes (unused bytes 0x00); multi-byte values little-endian
format.modes: ДЖР = executed only in standby (the BOS rejects / ignores it during a session); all = any mode
format.fields: byte = first byte, len = bytes (LE), bits = [hi, lo] within the byte, scale = units per LSB, values = allowed codes, strict = other codes prohibited, zero_bits = must be 0, parts = [[byte, hi, lo], …] value split over several places, least significant part first

commands.name: АФАР fast switch-on signal / command for a given time (no RF)
Delay in turning on the physical session (and OG tuning in session)

commands.name: Session transmission time (БШВ)
commands.note: Starts the session of the last configuration command (ШР preambles / ПООСШ / КБД) at this time; ignored when the BOS has no configuration yet or the time has passed.

fields.note: integer seconds since 01.01.1970 UTC (БШВ); 'now+30' = 30 s from now

commands.name: Change parameters in EPROM (ИОК_СОСТОЯНИЕ counters)
commands.note: Standby only; the BOS also checks the sender address. Writes EPROM (time ≤ Tpark).

fields.name: mask
fields.note: bytes of the value to write: bit k = value byte k

fields.name: address
fields.note: address in the ИОК_СОСТОЯНИЕ frame: 0 = bytes 11-8, 1 = 15-12, 2 = 19-16 … 9 = 47-44

fields.name: value
fields.note: value (LE); only the bytes in the mask are written

commands.name: DAC encoder 1 setup: QMC offsets / gains / phase, coarse_dac
commands.note: Kept until a BOS reset or МД SETUP. The values in use are in ИОК_ДОП (in session only: the DAC is off in standby).

commands.name: DAC encoder 2 setup: PLL VCO (pll_vco)
commands.note: Kept until a BOS reset or МД SETUP.

fields.name: pll_vco
fields.note: 100010…101000 (34…40), default 100101 (37); check memin_pll_lfvolt in ИОК_ДОП = 100 or 011

commands.name: Reference oscillator DAC (50 MHz OG frequency)
commands.note: Changes the BOS 50 MHz reference oscillator (and so the operating frequency). Select the internal 10 MHz source first (SET_Sour_10MHz = internal), otherwise the external oscillator tunes it. Kept until a reset or until the external 10 MHz source is selected; the values in use are in ИОК_ДОП.

fields.name: dac_data
fields.note: 12 bit 0x001…0xFFF; 1 LSB ≈ 150 Hz of the operating frequency
